UserVault.title: UserVault
UserVault.description: Per-user synced Pokies Vault state including saved accounts, visited domains, custom added domains, UI preferences, and last balance/bonus fetch snapshot. Casino login credentials remain strictly on-device.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase user UID who owns this vault.

visited.description: Bounded list of domain names marked as visited by the user.

mine.description: Bounded list of domain names saved in My Accounts.

customDomains.description: Bounded list of custom domains added by the user formatted as domain|addedAt.

lastFetchTimestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last account fetcher run (0 if none).

lastFetchRows.description: Bounded list of structured maps representing AccountResult rows from the last fetch.

themeId.description: Selected visual theme identifier (e.g. vault, matrix, gold, crimson, ocean).

bonusMode.description: Highlighted bonus category on directory cards.

notVisited.description: Filter toggle to show only unvisited sites.

wallets.description: Filter toggle to expand wallet rows on directory cards.

mineOnly.description: Filter toggle to show only saved accounts.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated user's isolated Pokies Vault cloud state.
